id.meaning: Owner application process name; kcm_componentchooser uses its dedicated settings scope.

benchmark.meaning: Shared timings when benchmarking is requested.

changed.meaning: The application was opened or stopped on a successful toggle.

program.meaning: Application process name in the result or error context.

running.meaning: Whether the application was observed running.

pid.meaning: Spawned supervisor PID or observed settings process PID when supplied.

launched.meaning: A launch returned before the follow-up process observation failed.

early_exit.meaning: Launcher status at the initial poll, null if still running.

exit.meaning: Nonzero early launcher exit on a failed launch when known.

signal_exit.meaning: Exit status of the stop command on a failed stop.

lock_path.meaning: Owner runtime lock file for this application.

socket_source.meaning: Owner session discovery sources, or not-required.

socket.meaning: Session key with ambiguous socket observations.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed stop outcomes; none denotes success. The shared envelope reader can also report which kernel keys are missing.
